humanReviewChecklist: Verify that the model ownership claim includes approval authority and presentation to the model risk committee as per the job requirement.
Confirm that the independent validation documentation meets the lender’s internal standards and that the candidate was the accountable developer.
Ensure that the monthly monitoring pack includes all required metrics (population stability index, Gini, override rates) and that drift was acted upon.
Clarify the extent of SQL work on loan‑level data beyond dataset construction.
Check that the candidate’s experience aligns with the lender’s governance and risk management processes.
